title: All Out Hypertrophy Program
author: Mohamad C.
desc: This program is built to optimize hypertrophy by combining progressive loading (60–85% ranges), moderate-to-high volume, and targeted muscle group splits. It ensures sufficient frequency and stimulus for each muscle while managing fatigue, making it ideal for intermediate lifters aiming for lean mass and symmetry.

On your last set, after performing 8 reps, rest for 20 seconds then perform another set as many reps as possible without dropping the weight.
Grip wider than shoulder width. When pulling down, keep the elbows tucked in.
Always keep your chest up and your back arched
Make sure the elbow is always on a higher level than the fist.
